reading.title: Remote Work and Productivity
reading.passage: Remote work has transformed modern employment landscapes significantly. Studies indicate that employees working from home demonstrate 13% higher productivity compared to office-based counterparts. However, isolation and reduced face-to-face collaboration present challenges. Companies implementing hybrid models report improved employee satisfaction and retention rates. Technology enables seamless communication through video conferencing and project management tools. Despite initial skepticism, remote work arrangements have proven sustainable for many organizations, reshaping workplace culture and employee expectations permanently.

questions.q: According to the passage, what is one advantage of remote work?
options: A) Reduced company expenses
B) Higher employee productivity
C) Easier management oversight
D) Faster project completion
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '재택근무 직원들은 사무실 기반 직원들에 비해 13% 더 높은 생산성을 보인다'고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: What challenge of remote work is mentioned in the passage?
options: A) High technology costs
B) Difficulty hiring employees
C) Isolation and reduced collaboration
D) Legal compliance issues
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '고립과 면대면 협업 감소가 도전 과제'라고 명시되어 있습니다.

questions.q: Which work model does the passage suggest improves employee satisfaction?
options: A) Fully remote
B) Fully office-based
C) Hybrid models
D) Rotating schedules
questions.explanation: 본문에서 '하이브리드 모델을 시행하는 회사들이 직원 만족도와 유지율 향상을 보고한다'고 나와있습니다.

writing.prompt: Do you agree or disagree with the statement: 'Remote work should be the standard employment model for all companies'? Use specific reasons and examples to support your position.

structure.intro: 명확한 입장 제시 (동의/반대). 배경 정보 1-2문장으로 제공. 논문의 방향성 암시.
structure.body1: 첫 번째 근거 제시. 구체적 사례나 데이터 인용. 주제문 + 설명 + 예시 구조.
structure.body2: 두 번째 근거 제시. 첫 번째와 다른 관점. 실생활 예시 또는 연구 기반 주장.
structure.conclusion: 입장 재강조. 본론의 주요 포인트 요약. 더 넓은 의미의 함축 또는 미래 전망 제시.

useful_phrases: In my opinion, remote work should/should not be the standard because...
First and foremost, this arrangement allows employees to...
Furthermore, companies benefit from reduced overhead costs and...
However, one significant drawback is that...
For instance, collaborative teams in creative industries require...
In conclusion, while remote work offers advantages, it is not universally suitable for...

speaking.prompt: Some people prefer working in a traditional office environment. Others prefer remote work. Which do you prefer and why?
useful_expressions: In my opinion, I prefer remote work because it allows me to...
One reason is that remote work provides flexibility and...
Another important factor is that I can concentrate better when...
This preference is based on my personal experience with...
sample_points: 유연성 - 출퇴근 시간 절약, 개인 일정 조절 가능, 일과 삶의 균형 개선
생산성 - 방해 요소 감소, 집중력 향상, 자신의 페이스대로 작업 가능

listening.title: Discussion on Workplace Communication
listening.script: Professor: Good morning, everyone. Today we're discussing effective workplace communication in the digital age. Sarah, in your survey about remote teams, what was the most surprising finding? Student: Well, Professor, we discovered that email isn't always the most effective tool. Many workers felt overwhelmed by excessive emails and preferred real-time communication through instant messaging or video calls. Professor: That's fascinating. Did you find generational differences in preferences? Student: Absolutely. Younger employees strongly favored video conferencing for complex discussions, while some senior staff still preferred traditional email for documentation purposes. They wanted a permanent record. Professor: This raises an important point. Organizations must balance immediacy with accountability. What recommendations did your study suggest? Student: We recommended a tiered communication strategy. Use instant messaging for quick questions, video calls for nuanced discussions, and email for formal records. This approach seemed to satisfy both preferences and improved overall team collaboration. Professor: Excellent research, Sarah. This reflects real workplace challenges organizations face today.

questions.q: What was the main finding of Sarah's survey?
options: A) Email is the best workplace communication tool
B) Remote workers prefer video calls over emails
C) Younger employees reject all traditional communication methods
D) Senior staff only use email for daily work
questions.explanation: 사라의 연구에서 이메일이 항상 효과적이지 않으며, 많은 근로자들이 즉시 메시지나 화상 통화를 선호한다고 밝혔습니다.

questions.q: What generational difference did Sarah's study identify?
options: A) Only young workers use technology
B) Older workers prefer video calls exclusively
C) Younger employees favored video conferencing; senior staff preferred email for records
D) No generational differences were found
questions.explanation: 본문에서 젊은 직원들은 화상 회의를 선호하고, 연장자 직원들은 기록을 위해 이메일을 선호한다고 명확히 나타나 있습니다.

questions.q: What tiered communication strategy did Sarah recommend?
options: A) Use only instant messaging for all communication
B) Instant messaging for quick questions, video calls for complex discussions, email for formal records
C) Eliminate email entirely from workplace communication
D) Use only video calls for all workplace matters
questions.explanation: 사라는 빠른 질문에는 즉시 메시지, 복잡한 논의에는 화상 통화, 공식 기록에는 이메일을 사용할 것을 권장했습니다.
